question: Can the installed transport stack reproduce the published OKTAVIAN LiF leakage spectrum with exact data normalization and explicit measurement comparison? This is a lithium-material qualification step, NOT beryllium breeding validation.
classification: existing benchmark reproduction, no novelty claim
original_experiment: Ichihara, Hayashi, Kobayashi, Kimura, Yamamoto, Izumi, Takahashi; OKTAVIAN measured sphere leakage reported at Nuclear Data for Science and Technology 1988
preexisting_data_issue: OFB helper radius is19.95cm while tally radius is30.5cm; archive first spectrum bin does not appear normalized like later bins. Preserve and audit before using any C/E label.
score_plan: Use original F1-compatible surface current per source, no empirical scaling. Convert to per-lethargy using exact high/low bin log ratio, match IAEA CSV by energy endpoint. Report all bins with errors, residuals, code-to-code agreement and limitations; no automatic reactor-validation label.
reopen_condition: No further runs unless missing files, failed geometry/unit tests or a decision-relevant declared precision gap is identified. Do not tune to make experimental agreement look better.
